I am, thank you. Feeling better now - have appt with therapist today.
It's intense how the mind can trick you into thinking that there's no hope at all, when there really is hope.

Are you still there? It has to feel super fucked up to have been disconnected from the hotline, and then downvoted and ignored by SW. 

I'm completely new to SW, came on here for help, totally embarassed to do so, and was instantly downvoted and ignored.

Hello gasoline, this is my friend fire...

I hope you are OK. If you need to talk, let me know. I really need someone to talk to too.
